confirm.title: Set up {name}
confirm.description:
Home Assistant found your xBloom machine over Bluetooth. Confirm to add it.

There's nothing else to set up: no account and no MQTT broker. You'll add recipes afterwards from the integration's *Configure* menu (paste a share link from the iOS app).

user.title: Set up xBloom Studio
user.description: Pick your machine from the list. Home Assistant currently sees {discovered_count} over Bluetooth. If yours isn't there, type its BLE name instead; you'll find it in the iOS app under *Settings → Machine* (it looks like *XBLOOM ABC123*).

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to xBloom again
reauth_confirm.description: Your xBloom session for {email} has expired and can't be refreshed on its own. Enter your password to sign in again and resume recipe sync.

error.ble_name_required: Pick a machine from the list, or type its BLE name.
error.ble_name_invalid: That doesn't look like a BLE name. They read like 'XBLOOM ABC123'; check it in the iOS app under machine settings.
error.cloud_login_failed: Sign-in failed. Check your xBloom email and password, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This xBloom machine is already set up.

init.title: xBloom recipe library
init.description: Create, edit, or remove recipes here. Signing in to your xBloom account to sync recipes with the cloud is optional; without it, recipes stay on this Home Assistant.

menu_options.add_recipe: Add a recipe from a share link

connection.title: Live-session timeout
connection.description: A Connect session holds the Bluetooth link open so Home Assistant can stream live readings and drive spoken announcements. That link lives on your Home Assistant host, not your phone, so it won't let go on its own when you close the dashboard. To avoid keeping the machine from the xBloom app, a session ends automatically after this many seconds of silence. Lower hands the machine back sooner; higher keeps live sessions alive longer. Default is 300 seconds (5 minutes).

data.idle_timeout_s: End the session after (seconds of silence)

firmware_flashing.title: Enable firmware flashing
firmware_flashing.description: Off by default. When on, the Firmware entity gains an **Install** button that sends updates to the machine over Bluetooth. The transfer is verified byte-for-byte against a genuine xBloom update, but ⚠️ flashing firmware is inherently risky: if the Bluetooth link drops mid-update it can brick the machine, and this hasn't been tested on real hardware yet. Only turn it on if you accept that risk.

cloud_login.title: Sign in to xBloom cloud
cloud_login.description: Sign in with your xBloom account to sync recipes and turn on cloud features (creating and editing recipes in the cloud, plus firmware update checks). Turn on **Remember my credentials** and the session refreshes itself automatically; your password is then stored locally on this Home Assistant and only ever sent to xBloom's sign-in endpoint. Leave it off for more privacy, and you'll be asked to sign in again whenever the session expires.

cloud_reconcile.title: You have local recipes
cloud_reconcile.description: Once you sign in, the xBloom cloud becomes the home for your recipes. What should happen to the {count} recipe(s) currently stored on this Home Assistant?

menu_options.cloud_upload: Upload my local recipes to the cloud
menu_options.cloud_replace: Discard local recipes and use the cloud

cloud_logout.title: Sign out of xBloom cloud
cloud_logout.description: Sign out of {email}? Your recipes go back to the local library (synced ones stay cached here). Firmware updates and cloud recipe editing won't be available until you sign in again.

add_recipe.title: Add a recipe
add_recipe.description: In the xBloom iOS app, open the recipe and tap **Share → Copy Link**, then paste it here. You can also paste just the share id (the part after `?id=`).

create_recipe.title: New recipe: choose a dripper
create_recipe.description: Name your recipe and choose the dripper or cup. The dose range in the next step follows that choice: xPod is fixed at 15 g, the Omni dripper takes 5–18 g, Other takes 5–25 g, and Tea takes 1–5 g.

create_recipe_pours.title: Set the pours
create_recipe_pours.description: Target: {total_ml} ml ({dose} g × {ratio}). Each pour is pre-filled at {per_pour_ml} ml. Current total: {current_total_ml} ml. The pours must add up to exactly {total_ml} ml, or the recipe is rejected.

edit_recipe.title: Edit a recipe
edit_recipe.description: Choose a recipe to edit. The next step lets you change its brewing parameters.

write_to_slot.title: Write to a machine slot?
write_to_slot.description: Optional: write {recipe_name} to one of the machine's slots (A, B, or C) so you can brew it from the machine alone. Choose 'skip' to finish without writing.

create_recipe_brew.title: Brew parameters
create_recipe_brew.description: Cup type: {cup}. The dose is limited to that cup's range. Ratio is the brew ratio 1:N (5–25, in steps of 0.5).

coffee_lab.title: Coffee Lab
coffee_lab.description: Track bags of coffee and what each brew uses.

start_brew.name: Start Brew
start_brew.description: Brew a recipe on the xBloom Studio. Uses the recipe selected in select.xbloom_studio_recipe unless you pass recipe_name. The dose, ratio, and grind_size fields are optional one-off overrides for this brew only — the saved recipe is left untouched.

recipe_name.name: Recipe name
recipe_name.description: Brew this recipe instead of the selected one. Must match a name in select.xbloom_studio_recipe exactly. Leave blank to use the current selection.

share_url.name: Share URL
share_url.description: Brew straight from an xBloom app share URL (e.g. https://share-h5.xbloom.com/?id=...). Fetched fresh — the recipe does not have to be in the library first, and nothing is saved.

share_id.name: Share ID
share_id.description: Just the id token (the value after `?id=` in a share URL).

use_preground.name: Use pre-ground coffee
use_preground.description: Skip the grinder and go straight to pouring, for this brew only. The recipe's grind settings are not changed. Handy with pre-ground coffee or an external grinder.

dose.name: Dose override (g)
dose.description: One-off coffee dose in grams. The recipe is rescaled to dose × ratio for this brew only. Leave blank to use the recipe's own dose.

ratio.name: Ratio override (1:N)
ratio.description: One-off brew ratio N, where water = dose × N. Rescales the pours for this brew only. Leave blank to use the recipe's own ratio.

grind_size.name: Grind size override
grind_size.description: One-off grind size for this brew only (1–80, lower is finer). Leave blank to use the recipe's own grind size.

bean_id.name: Bag
bean_id.description: Coffee Lab only: the id of the bag this brew's coffee comes from. Leave blank to use the selected bag.

unattributed.name: From no bag
unattributed.description: Coffee Lab only: the coffee comes from no bag, as with an xPod.

context.name: Context
context.description: Any value, returned unchanged in every event of this brew.

stop_brew.name: Stop Brew
stop_brew.description: Cancel the brew in progress. Home Assistant connects over Bluetooth, sends the stop command, and disconnects.

brew_standalone.name: Standalone Brew
brew_standalone.description: Run the brewer on its own, without a recipe, using the current standalone brew entities: number.xbloom_studio_brew_flow_rate, number.xbloom_studio_brew_volume, number.xbloom_studio_brew_temperature, select.xbloom_studio_brew_pattern, and select.xbloom_studio_water_source. Set those first, then call this action.

tare.name: Tare Scale
tare.description: Zero the machine's built-in scale. Home Assistant connects over Bluetooth, sends the command, and disconnects.

back_to_home.name: Back to Home
back_to_home.description: Return the machine's on-screen display to the home screen.

brew_pause.name: Pause Brew
brew_pause.description: Pause a brew in progress. The machine holds at the current pour; use Resume Brew to carry on.

grind.name: Standalone Grind
grind.description: Run the grinder on its own for a set time. Home Assistant holds the Bluetooth link for the full grind, then disconnects.

seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
seconds.description: How long to grind, 1–30 seconds. Default 5.

set_mode.name: Set Mode
set_mode.description: Switch the machine between Auto Mode and Pro Mode. "Auto" is the label the machine and app use; internally it's the same as EasyMode.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: auto = Auto Mode: pick a saved recipe (A/B/C) and the machine grinds and brews it. pro = Pro Mode: drive the grinder, brewer, and scale yourself.

set_water_source.name: Set Water Source
set_water_source.description: Switch between the internal water tank and an external tap.

set_temp_unit.name: Set Temperature Unit
set_temp_unit.description: Set the temperature unit shown on the machine's display.

set_weight_unit.name: Set Weight Unit
set_weight_unit.description: Set the weight unit shown on the machine's display.

write_slot.name: Write Recipe to Slot
write_slot.description: Save a recipe to one of the machine's three on-device slots (A / B / C). Once written, you can brew it from the machine's own controls with no Home Assistant involvement. Pass exactly one of recipe_name, share_url, or share_id to choose the recipe; if none is given, the currently selected recipe is used.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Which on-device slot to overwrite (A, B, or C).

recipe_name.name: Recipe name
recipe_name.description: Name of a recipe in the local library (matches select.xbloom_studio_recipe).

share_url.name: Share URL
share_url.description: A share URL from the xBloom iOS app (e.g. https://share-h5.xbloom.com/?id=...). Fetched fresh — no need to import it from the Configure menu first.

share_id.name: Share ID
share_id.description: Just the id token (the value after `?id=` in a share URL).

scale_on.name: Scale enabled
scale_on.description: Whether the slot turns on the built-in scale at brew time. Default on.

ble_connect.name: BLE Connect (diagnostic)
ble_connect.description: Test the Bluetooth link: connect, run the handshake, subscribe to notifications, then release and disconnect. Each step is logged with a success or failure note. For diagnosing connection problems; it doesn't touch the brew flow.

ble_disconnect.name: BLE Disconnect (diagnostic)
ble_disconnect.description: Release any Bluetooth link Home Assistant is holding for the machine, so the iOS app can reconnect. The counterpart to BLE Connect.

refresh_status.name: Refresh status
refresh_status.description: Briefly connect to the machine, capture one status update (water, grind size, mode, water source, units, voltage), then disconnect — refreshing the status sensors on demand without opening a live Connect session. You can await it from an automation and then act on the fresh readings.

list_recipes.name: List Recipes
list_recipes.description: Return every recipe in the local library as response data. Call with return_response=true (for example from the REST API).

get_recipe.name: Get Recipe
get_recipe.description: Return a single recipe by name as response data, or null if it isn't found.

build_recipe.name: Build Recipe
build_recipe.description: Turn loose recipe fields into a brewable recipe. Every value is snapped onto the machine's grid rather than rejected — a ratio of 1:16.3 becomes 1:16.5, a 105 °C pour becomes 98 °C — and the response lists each change in plain language, so a caller can tell the user what was adapted. Made for callers working from a recipe as a person described it (a web recipe, a spoken request) rather than a validated form. Only faults that cannot be snapped away — a missing name, more pours than the machine accepts, a single pour over 240 ml — come back as errors. The response carries ok, recipe, adjustments and errors. With save: true the recipe is stored in the same call: it replaces the recipe named by id when one is given, and adds a new one otherwise.

dose.name: Dose (g)
dose.description: Coffee dose in grams. Snapped to the chosen cup's range — 15 g exactly for an xPod, 5–18 g for the Omni dripper, 5–25 g for Other, 1–5 g for Tea. Defaults to the cup's own default.

ratio.name: Ratio
ratio.description: Brew ratio, as "1:16" or just the number 16. Water is dose × ratio. Snapped to the 0.5 grid within 5–25.

cup_type.name: Cup type
cup_type.description: The brewer in use, by name or by id — xPod (1), Omni dripper (2), Other (3), Tea (4). Defaults to the Omni dripper.

pour_count.name: Pour count
pour_count.description: How many pours to generate when you don't supply them yourself, 1–9. Ignored when pours_json is given. Defaults to 3.

pours_json.name: Pours JSON
pours_json.description: The pours, as a JSON array of objects. Every field is optional and anything left out is filled in: volume_ml, temperature_c, flow_rate, pause_s, pattern (such as spiral), agitate_before and agitate_after (1 on, 2 off). Volumes that don't sum to dose × ratio are rescaled proportionally, so the shape of the recipe survives. Leave blank to generate pours from pour_count.

id.name: Recipe id
id.description: The id of an existing recipe. With save, the recipe is replaced rather than added — this is how an edit avoids leaving a duplicate behind.

save.name: Save
save.description: Store the result. Off by default, so you can build a recipe and show it to the user before committing to it.

apply_brew_defaults.name: Apply brewing defaults
apply_brew_defaults.description: On by default: the first pour gets a bloom pause targeting a 60-second window, later pours pause 10 seconds, and any pause between 1 and 9 seconds is lifted to 10. These are brewing preferences, not machine limits — turn this off to get the machine's own defaults, where an unspecified pause is simply zero.

add_recipe.name: Add Recipe
add_recipe.description: Add a new recipe to the local library, replacing any existing recipe with the same name. Pass the full recipe as a JSON string. The recipe is validated before it's stored, using the same rules as the Configure flow (dose range per cup type, ratio 1:5–1:25 in 0.5 steps, grind 1–80, RPM 60–120 in steps of 10, per-pour temperature/flow/pattern, and pour volumes summing to dose × ratio). If validation fails, nothing is written and the response has ok set to false, a summary in error, and the reason for each field in errors.

recipe_json.name: Recipe JSON
recipe_json.description: The full recipe object as a JSON string.

update_recipe.name: Update Recipe
update_recipe.description: Update (replace) an existing recipe by id. Pass the full updated recipe as a JSON string. If no recipe with that id exists, it's inserted. Validated before writing, exactly like Add Recipe. If validation fails, nothing is written and the response has ok set to false, a summary in error, and the reason for each field in errors.

recipe_json.name: Recipe JSON
recipe_json.description: The full updated recipe object as a JSON string.

delete_recipe.name: Delete Recipe
delete_recipe.description: Delete a recipe from the local library by name.

save_scaled_recipe.name: Save Scaled Recipe
save_scaled_recipe.description: The brew customizer's "Save as new recipe": take a recipe, rescale it to dose × ratio (with an optional new grind size), and save the result as a NEW recipe under new_name — stored locally when signed out, or in the cloud with a local mirror when signed in. The source recipe is never changed.

dose.name: Dose (g)
dose.description: Coffee dose in grams for the new recipe.

ratio.name: Ratio (1:N)
ratio.description: Brew ratio N, where water = dose × N, for the new recipe.

grind_size.name: Grind size
grind_size.description: Grind size for the new recipe (1–80, lower is finer).

recipe_name.name: Source recipe name
recipe_name.description: The recipe to scale from. Leave blank to use the currently selected recipe (select.xbloom_studio_recipe).
